title: Colours
introduction: Learn about colours through simple examples and practice.
definition: Colour words describe how things look.
rules: Look at objects around you and name their colours.

vocabulary.description: The colour of many ripe strawberries.
The colour of a clear daytime sky.
The colour of a ripe banana.

examples.question: What colour is fresh grass usually?
steps: Read or listen to the question. Think about what you have learnt.

exercises.question: What colour is fresh grass usually?
What colour is a ripe banana usually?

summary: Colour words describe how things look.
